high_level_description: This image is a meme featuring a conversation between two characters from the movie "The Dark Knight Rises." The setting appears to be an office or a formal meeting room with large windows in the background, allowing natural light to enter. The first character, dressed in a suit and tie, is speaking to the second character, who is also dressed formally but in a more relaxed manner. The first character says, "I want 10 million dollars, a year, for the rest of my life." The second character, who has a distinguished appearance with gray hair and a mustache, listens intently.
